content: Internal Revenue Service Business Compliance. This is Officer Miller. Who am I speaking with today?
Hello, uh, my name is Priya Mehra. I received a voicemail saying something about my business taxes?

Thank you, Ms. Mehra. I'm reviewing your file right now. Our records show your LLC failed to submit essential payroll tax forms and 1099 documentation. The IRS takes these matters extremely seriously.
Oh, I don't understand. I thought my accountant filed everything. Is something missing?
Unfortunately, yes. You missed critical compliance deadlines. The IRS issued two certified notices, but you did not respond. This puts your business at severe risk of federal penalty.
I never got any letters. What penalty? My business is so small, I can't afford a big fine.

Under federal code, failure to comply triggers automatic fines, audits, and possible revocation of your business registration. Since you have not rectified this, your case is being escalated for asset freeze and possible referral to immigration authorities.
Asset freeze? Immigration? Please, I can't have problems with my visa. Is there anything I can do?
Ms. Mehra, I want to help, but time is extremely limited. If you act quickly today, there is a way to resolve this before formal actions begin. However, you must follow my instructions precisely.
Yes, of course, please. I just want to fix this. What do I need to do?

The IRS requires immediate payment of the outstanding compliance penalty to halt the proceedings. You cannot pay by check or through your accountant. To avoid escalation, payment must be processed using an approved digital method today.
Digital method? I'm not sure what you mean.

For security, we only accept payment via either a direct wire transfer or by purchasing electronic prepaid cards. I will give you exact instructions. Do not discuss this with anyone, as that could be considered interfering with an IRS investigation.
Okay, okay. How much do I have to pay? I really don't have a lot of savings.
The compliance fine is $3,800. If you delay even an hour, it increases to $5,000 and triggers an automatic audit. If you cannot pay in full, you need to tell me how much you can arrange right now.
I, I might be able to do $2,000 from my account, but I need to transfer from savings.

Good, that's a start. Here is what you must do: Go to your nearest store and purchase $2,000 in Apple or Google Play gift cards. Once you have the cards, remain on the line and read me the codes. Do not disconnect the call or speak with store employees about this.
Gift cards? Isn't that strange? Why not just a regular payment?

Due to ongoing IRS security upgrades, gift cards are temporarily used for urgent compliance payments. If you do not comply, your file will be marked as refusing to cooperate, and enforcement will proceed. Do you understand?
Y-yes, I understand. Will this stop the penalties and the immigration issue?
It will halt all actions once the payment is processed. After you give me the codes, I will send you a release confirmation. Do not hang up or speak to anyone. Are you ready to go to the store now?
I guess so. I'm leaving now. Can you wait while I buy the cards?
Yes, I will stay on the line for your security. Remember, do not mention the IRS or this call to anyone at the store. If you do, it could trigger an automatic fraud alert and escalate your case.
Okay, okay. I'm heading out now. Please, I don't want any trouble. Will you stay here?
I'm here with you. As soon as you have the gift cards, return to your car and read me the codes. After that, I will confirm your payment and update your IRS file. Do not delay.
